title: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-group Rescaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.28388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks. We propose Self-Credit, an end-to-end agentic RL method that creates dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards using self-generated credit assignment via intra-group rescaling. Self-Credit builds on group-based RL with three components. First, during its rollouts, the policy model generates summaries with citations to earlier turns containing critical evidence, which serve as self-generated credit. Second, we refine this model-generated credit with intra-group rescaling, which compares cited actions across successful and failed rollouts for the same prompt. This approach uses group-level agreement and disagreement to remove undeserved credit and further emphasize credit assigned to critical actions. translated_title: Self-Credit：基于组内重缩放的长程智能体强化学习信用分配方法
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通常使用RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）进行训练，但典型RLVR奖励的稀疏性使得信用分配极具挑战性，在长程任务中尤其如此。我们提出了Self-Credit，这是一种端到端的智能体强化学习方法，通过组内重缩放的自生成信用分配机制，从稀疏的结果奖励中构建密集的监督信号。Self-Credit建立在组式强化学习之上，包含三个组件：首先，在策略模型进行rollout的过程中，它会生成带有引用的摘要，引用那些包含关键证据的较早轮次，作为自生成的信用；其次，我们通过组内重缩放来精炼模型生成的信用，即针对同一提示比较成功与失败rollout中被引用的动作，利用组级别的一致性与不一致性去除不当的信用，并进一步强化分配给关键动作的信用；第三，优势重加权利用重缩放后的信用权重来更新……
tldr: 提出Self-Credit方法，通过让策略模型自生成带引用的摘要信用，并利用组内对成功与失败rollout的比较进行重缩放，从稀疏结果奖励中为长程智能体强化学习构建密集的信用分配信号。
en_tdlr: Self-Credit enables dense credit assignment for long-horizon agentic RL by having the policy model self-generate citation-based credit from sparse outcome rewards and refining it through intra-group rescaling across successful and failed rollouts.
